Lean `turn P i = chi P (i-1) i (i+1) = sign det (P i − P (i−1)) (P (i+1) − P (i−1))` (work/lean/SM/Chirotope.lean:10-14) is verbatim the printed τ_i = χ_{i−1,i,i+1} = sgn det(μ_i−μ_{i−1}, μ_{i+1}−μ_{i−1}) (sm-1-polygons.tex:63-70); `turn_det` gives sgn det(incoming edge, outgoing edge). Printed def:chirotope fixes left = +1 (ℓ(P) = #{τ_i = 1}), hence right = −1. `carrierWeight` (statement lines 24-26) maps all `= -1` → 1 (right) and all `= 1` → (−1)^k (left): correct orientation. At smoothing corners the corner-polygon turn is sgn det(d_i, d_j) with i the edge arrived along (`ccpCornerPolygon_turn_eq_sign`/`_turn_smoothing`, lines 588-616) because the corner polygon's edges are positive multiples of the original edge directions (`ccpCornerPolygon_edge`, `_edge_pred`); this is the printed carrier turn at a smoothing corner ("arrives along one of lt_i, lt_j and leaves along the other", def:smoothing sm-3:14-28). No configuration flips a sign.

(3) k(L) = ccpCornerCount. `ccpCornerCount = (ccpCornerList).length`, `ccpCornerList = (componentMarkList q).filter (IsTrueCorner S)` (CarrierCornerPolygon.lean:317-343); `IsTrueCorner S a` holds for every original-vertex mark and for a visit v exactly when `v.1 ∈ S` (`ccp_not_trueCorner`, lines 123-127). Each vertex mark and each selected-visit mark is owned by exactly one component (Component = orbits of `smoothingSuccessor`, CarrierSmoothing.lean:124-132). By `ccp_selected_crossing_two_corners` (lines 620-654, under `hS`) the two visits of a selected crossing are owned by two DISTINCT carriers (`q ≠ q'`) and each is a corner of its carrier with turns sgn det(d_i,d_j) and sgn det(d_j,d_i) (one left, one right). Therefore per carrier: #owned vertex marks = #vertices of P it passes through, and #owned selected visits = #crossing points of S it turns at (exactly one smoothing corner per carrier through a site). This is precisely the printed corner set (def:smoothing: "the vertices of P it passes through and the crossing points of S it turns at"), so ccpCornerCount = k(L) exactly; unselected visits are corners in neither. The printed proof's arithmetic Σ_{all-left L} k(L) = ℓ(P)+|S| is consistent with this count. The only way to overcount (a carrier owning both visits of one selected crossing) is excluded for independent S.

(4) "Mixed". weight_mixed's hypotheses `(¬ ∀ j, turn = -1) → (¬ ∀ j, turn = 1)` are propositionally equivalent to `CarrierMixed = ¬ ∃ τ : SignType, τ ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ j, turn = τ` (work/lean/SM/UniformDefinition.lean:27-34), because SignType has exactly the three values {−1,0,1} so `τ ≠ 0` ⟺ τ ∈ {−1,1}; this matches printed def:uniform "mixed otherwise" (not all turns of one sign) even for hypothetical zero-turn carriers. The three cases are exhaustive (else-branch) and exclusive: `ZMod (ccpCornerCount …)` is nonempty (`ccpCornerCount_neZero`; ≥ 3 under hS by `ccpCornerCount_ge_three`), so "all −1" and "all 1" cannot both hold and the if-priority is immaterial.

(c)-(e). `wind = ∏ q : Component hn hP S, carrierWeight …` is the product over the Fintype of carriers of S (`componentFintype`) = ∏_L wt(L). `selector_form`: `cornerStateSum hn hP = Σ_{S ∈ (independentSupports hn hP).attach} wind S.1 * cornerProduct S.1 S.2`, where `cornerProduct = ∏ q, cornerCoefficient hn hP S q hS` and `cornerCoefficient` = [a^{d_Q} z^0] homfly(positiveLift) from def:C (def-C statement lines 103-112, 158-160), i.e. c(L) "remains the coefficient of the actual positive carrier lift"; `S.2 : S.1 ∈ independentSupports` is definitionally `IsDecomposition` (DecompositionDefinition.lean:15-17); Ind(G_P) includes ∅ in both (`empty_mem_independentSupports`). Printed eq. C-selector-form is reproduced clause for clause.

Non-blocking observations only: the definitional fields are stated for all S (printed defines wt only on carriers of independent supports), and weight_mixed spells out "mixed" as the two negations rather than naming `CarrierMixed`; both are equivalent/harmless. No concrete configuration exists in which carrierWeight ≠ wt(L), so the selector stands.

Not refuted. Every attack vector named in the task fails on inspection.

(1) Index set. `selector_form` (statement file lines 54-56) sums over `(independentSupports hn hP).attach`. `independentSupports` is `Finset.univ.powerset.filter (interlacementGraph hn hP).IsIndepSet` (work/lean/SM/InterlaceSupports.lean:27-30), a Finset, so no support appears with multiplicity; `Finset.attach` is a bijection onto the subtype (Mathlib `Finset.sum_attach`), so each S in Ind(G_P) is summed exactly once, none skipped, none doubled. There is no uniformity filter, so non-uniform supports are included exactly as the printed Σ_{S∈Ind(G_P)} requires (they contribute 0 via wind), and the empty support is included (`empty_mem_independentSupports`, InterlaceSupports.lean:44-47; also sm-1-polygons.tex:264 "including ∅"). The membership proof `S.2 : S.1 ∈ independentSupports hn hP` is accepted for the `IsDecomposition hn hP S.1` argument because `IsDecomposition` is defined as exactly that membership (work/lean/SM/DecompositionDefinition.lean:15-17).

(2) cornerProduct. `cornerProduct hn hP S hS := ∏ q : Component hn hP S, cornerCoefficient hn hP S q hS` (def-C file lines 158-160), and `cornerCoefficient = coeffAt (cornerSlot hn hP S q) 0 (homfly (positiveLift hn hP S q hS))` (lines 103-112), i.e. def:C's c(Q) = [a^{d_Q} z^0] H⁺_Q on the positive lift — "the coefficient of the actual positive carrier lift in Definition def:C". The product ranges over the same `Component hn hP S` Fintype (CarrierSmoothing.lean:124-126, 161-163) that `wind` uses (statement file 29-31), i.e. all carriers L of S (|S|+1 of them by lem:carriers (i)). By proof irrelevance the value does not depend on which `hS` is supplied.

(3) Sign (−1)^{ℓ(P)}. The Lean `cornerStateSum` carries the factor `(-1) ^ leftTurns P *` (def-C file 166-170) and the RHS of `selector_form` has no prefactor; the printed identity is C(P) (which by def:C, sm-3:1688-1700, contains (−1)^{ℓ(P)}) = Σ wind(S) ∏ c(L) with no prefactor. Same placement. Turn conventions match: `turn P i = chi P (i-1) i (i+1)` with `turn_det : turn P i = sign (det (edge P (i-1)) (edge P i))` (Chirotope.lean:13-14, 87-93) = τ_i = sgn det(d_{i−1}, d_i) (sm-1:63-72, sm-3:59-60); left = 1, `leftTurns P = #{i : turn P i = 1}` (Chirotope.lean:16-17) = ℓ(P). `carrierWeight` (statement 22-26) returns 1 when all turns are −1 (right), (−1)^{ccpCornerCount} when all are 1 (left), else 0 — the printed wt with the printed convention.

(4) The identity holds on every polygon with these conventions, so the Lean cannot differ from the printed one on some P. Concretely: for S = ∅, `Component hn hP ∅` is a singleton (CarrierSmoothing.lean:171-186), the single carrier is P with k = n, wt = 1 if ℓ(P) = 0 and (−1)^n if ℓ(P) = n, agreeing with def:C's (−1)^{ℓ(P)}(−1)^0. In general `ccpCornerPolygon_turn_vertex` (CarrierCornerPolygon.lean:598-604) gives each original-vertex corner the turn τ_i and `ccp_selected_crossing_two_corners` (lines 618-625, 838-845) gives each selected crossing two smoothing corners on two different carriers with opposite nonzero signs, so the total number of left carrier corners is ℓ(P)+|S|; for uniform S the all-left carriers hold all of them, hence wind(S) = (−1)^{Σ_{all-left L} k(L)} = (−1)^{ℓ(P)+|S|}, matching def:C's (−1)^{ℓ(P)}(−1)^{|S|}; for non-uniform S some carrier has neither all −1 nor all 1 turns, so wind(S) = 0, matching the absence of S from def:C's sum (cornerStateSum_eq_sum_independentSupports, def-C file 174-180).

(5) wt exhaustive/exclusive. `ccpCornerCount ≥ 1` always (`ccpCornerCount_neZero`, CarrierCornerPolygon.lean:345-347) and ≥ 3 with nonzero turns for independent S (`ccpCornerCount_ge_three` 691-693, `ccpCornerPolygon_turn_ne_zero` 579-584), so "all −1" and "all 1" are exclusive and the `else` branch is exactly def:uniform's "mixed" (`CarrierMixed = ¬∃ τ ≠ 0, ∀ j, turn = τ` over SignType, UniformDefinition.lean:27-34, is logically ¬(all −1) ∧ ¬(all 1)). The bundle's weight_right/weight_left/weight_mixed/wind_eq fields (statement 36-51) are definitional unfoldings. They quantify over all S, not just independent S, so for non-independent S the Lean asserts values of wt that the printed text leaves undefined — an extension, not a contradiction, and unused in `selector_form`; non-blocking. `hP : Generic P`, `hn : 3 ≤ n` is the implicit domain of Ind(G_P), def:C and lem:carriers (sm-3:54-57), so restricting to generic P is not a discrepancy.

No concrete polygon or support on which the Lean `selector_form` and the printed eq. C-selector-form disagree was found; the identity is stated with the same index set, the same per-carrier weight, the same c(L), and the same placement of (−1)^{ℓ(P)}.
